      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#047857"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#064e3b"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="1.5" y="1.5" width="41" height="41" rx="12" fill="url(#mdBg3)" stroke="url(#mdBorder3)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Orbital Ring & Cardinal Marks -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="22" r="14" stroke="#34d399" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="22" r="17.5" stroke="#10b981" stroke-opacity="0.15" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Cardinal Tick Marks -->
  <line x1="22" y1="5" x2="22" y2="7.5" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="22" x2="36.5" y2="22" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="39" x2="22" y2="36.5" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>

    <polygon points="22,8 25,22 22,20 19,22" fill="url(#needleNorth)"/>
    <!-- South Needle (Deep Emerald) -->
    <polygon points="22,36 25,22 22,24 19,22" fill="url(#needleSouth)"/>

    <circle cx="22" cy="22" r="3.2" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="22" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
